absent: Locking and lifetime rules for stage one walk information and filter private data beyond walker shared handling.
Full behavior and error returns of the complete stage two initializer behind the default wrapper.
Failure handling for allocation and translation callbacks in memory operations.
Interrupt, preemption and concurrency constraints for visitor and filter callbacks.
Architectural effects of overlay, access never, hierarchical disable and hardware access controls during walks.
Concrete values of fixed bases, CPU counts, table fanout, page shifts and feature capability queries.
Reclamation and freeing discipline for unlinked tables under concurrent readers.
Ordering between cache maintenance, invalidation skipping and atomic replacement sequences.

findings.text: Page table depth uses negative one for the earliest level and three for the deepest level. The minimum level that may hold a block mapping has two build variants, one permitting level one and another requiring level two.

A KVM entry is a sixty four bit unsigned value. The lowest bit signals validity. The next bit encodes type with zero for block and one for both page and table. Separate masks cover the standard address field and the extended large addressing form plus extra high bits for fifty two bit handling with sixteen kilobyte pages. An all ones value marks an invalid physical address.

Leaf low attributes occupy bits two through eleven with distinct stage one and stage two interpretations for index or memory type, permission, shareability and accessed state. Leaf high attributes occupy bits fifty through sixty three with a four bit software area plus execute controls that differ by stage and a guard bit. Inner shareable is value three. Stage one permission encodings for read only and read write each select between two values based on a final CPU mode capability. Stage two permissions aggregate the low read and write bits with the high execute range.

Protection uses low single bit positions for privileged execute, unprivileged execute, write, read, device and normal non cacheable, and high positions in the fifties for four software flags. Read with write forms the writable combination and adding execute forms the fully accessible combination. Host memory reuses the fully accessible form while host MMIO reuses read write. Hypervisor mappings define read write, read with execute, read only and device combinations. Nested level tagging reuses the first two software flags as one combined field.

Walk control defines seven single bit options for leaf, table pre order, table post order, shared, ignore restart, skip invalidation after break before make, and skip cache maintenance. Stage two creation defines two options for identity mapping and for treating stage two as stage one. Invalid entries tag the top four bits with a type and leave the rest for annotation. Defined tags are locked during break before make with value one, donated away from the host, and poisoned after reclaim from the guest.

Fixed limits are two hundred fifty five protected guests, one hundred twenty eight hypervisor memory regions, one page per firmware mailbox, forty objects per KVM memory cache, sixteen megabytes for PCI IO, and negative one hundred twenty seven for disabled stage one translation. Translation regimes distinguish three cases for the two low exception combinations and the high exception level. Range invalidation page counts derive from a count and scale pair.

Stage one walk context holds a pointer to walk information with a table address and a numeric level. A filter pairs a callback taking context and opaque data with private state. Walk information carries the filter, base address, regime, maximum output bits, page shift, address size, start level, shareability and boolean controls for low privilege access, hierarchical disable, overlay enables, access never, endianness, stage two, fifty two bit physical and hardware access handling. The result is a union of a success record with descriptor, resolved address, level, table accumulations, global marker, identifier and per privilege outcomes versus a failure record with fault code and two walk indicators, plus an overall failed flag.

Page table memory operations are supplied as callbacks for zeroed page allocation, exact sized allocation, exact freeing, unlinked table freeing with level, reference get and put and count query, address translation in both directions, and data plus instruction cache maintenance. Memory encryption operations supply encrypt and decrypt over a page range. A protected mapping node links into an ordered tree with guest and host frame numbers, a packed count of forty eight bits plus a non cacheable bit, and an internal subtree bound.

A visit context carries the entry location, prior value, callback argument, memory operations, range bounds with current address, level and walk options. A walker bundles a callback and argument with walk options, all immutable after creation. The page table header is either a cached ordered root for protected mappings or a record with input address size, start level, root pointer, memory operations and stage two only policy plus predicate, always with a stage two context pointer. The root pointer has two builds, a plain pointer and an annotated pointer for concurrent reclamation.

Nested level encoding packs the translation level into the combined software area. Contiguous shift is zero without the contiguous hint. With the hint it is four for the smallest pages, five for the largest pages, and for the middle size five at level two versus seven otherwise. Range invalidation decoding extracts granule, base, scale, count and optionally an identifier, treats a zero granule code as the largest size, sign extends the base from bit forty eight, derives span from count and scale shifted by granule size, then caps the span to stay within the low or high address half.

Size codes zero through five map to thirty two, thirty six, forty, forty two, forty four and forty eight output bits. Code six yields fifty two only with fifty two bit support, otherwise it falls through to forty eight, and any other code also yields forty eight. Maximum physical range is fifty two when large addressing is enabled or when fifty two bit pages use the middle size, otherwise forty eight. The effective range from the CPU feature register is clamped down to that maximum.

Validity is tested from the low bit. Translation between entries and addresses masks the main field and relocates extra high bits according to large addressing mode and middle page size. Frame numbers derive through the address translation. Granule shift for a level assumes three as the deepest level with size as two raised to that shift. Block use is allowed at or above the minimum block level. Supported sizes form a mask over those levels and a size qualifies only when it is a power of two present in that mask.

Failing a stage one walk records the fault code and the page table walk indicator into both walk markers and raises the failed flag. A translated walk is recognized by a level different from the disabled marker. Fixed mapping for virtualized controls checks that the supplied index is below the CPU count and traps otherwise, then derives the slot by subtracting the index from the region base.

Per region vmemmap sizing converts region size to pages, scales by entry size, then expands to page boundaries. Totals sum over all hypervisor regions and convert back to pages. Guest table sizing covers the maximum guest pointer array rounded to pages. Worst case provisioning repeatedly divides page counts by entries per table from the first to the last level and accumulates. Totals cover all regions at page granularity. Stage one adds cover for one gigabyte of private area while host stage two adds sixteen extra pages for joined roots plus one gigabyte for MMIO. Firmware proxy adds two mailbox pages to the rounded worst case descriptor. Host vector state is zero without vector support, otherwise sized from the maximum vector length. Self test reserves either thirty two pages or zero depending on build.

Capability gating in protected mode allows the interrupt controller, power coordination versions, vCPU counts and identifiers, MSI identifier, IPA size and address plus generic pointer authentication. Tagging extension, eager split size and supported block sizes are always denied. Any other extension is allowed only without a guest or with a non protected guest. Control gating first resolves the control to a capability and denies on failure, otherwise it defers to the extension decision.

Assembly alignment derives from the configured function alignment in directive and string forms. Function symbols offer global, local, weak and typed spellings with aligned and unaligned variants, each emitting a start marker plus a branch target hint. The current location is captured with a PC relative read. Page table BSS uses a dedicated section with page alignment. Atomic sequences choose between legacy and extension forms through an alternative keyed on capability with a preamble enabling the extension, and unprivileged access instructions have their own enabling preamble.

PCI IO spans sixteen megabytes. Vmemmap range spans from the page offset to the end of the minimum virtual space with size from page count times page record size. Authentication register offsets are relative to the low key. DMA is forced unencrypted in realm world or protected guests, with one helper setting the shared marker and another clearing it to canonical form. Stage two initialization with defaults delegates to the full initializer with no flags and no predicate. Shared walk detection tests the shared option in the visit context. Header guards mark each header as processed.

In the hypervisor build without concurrent reclamation, pointer dereference is direct, walk start rejects shared requests with a permission failure and otherwise succeeds, walk end does nothing, and the held query always reports true. In the kernel build with concurrent reclamation, dereference is checked against the shared option so shared walks run protected while exclusive walks assert no protection, raw dereference bypasses the check, walk start takes protection only for shared walks and walk end releases it symmetrically, and the held query reflects protection state. Shared mode is fixed by the walker options for the whole walk.

Inline services provide nested level packing, range invalidation decoding, contiguous shift evaluation, size code conversion, large addressing and range queries, entry validity plus address and frame conversions, granule and block support queries, walk sharing tests, stage two setup, protected capability and control checks, hypervisor memory and table sizing, firmware and vector sizing, self test sizing, walk fault marking and translation tests, and DMA encryption queries for direct use by callers.

Three callback shapes serve as entry points. A walk filter is invoked with mutable walk context and opaque data and returns an integer disposition. A table visitor is invoked with a visit context and returns an integer disposition. A force page predicate observes an address interval and returns a boolean. Memory operation, encryption and walker records carry such callbacks for allocation, freeing, counting, translation, maintenance, protection and visitation.

A stage one result is either translated with descriptor and resolved address and accumulated permissions and a clear failed flag, or failed with fault code and walk markers and a set failed flag. The fail helper moves the record into failed and translation testing distinguishes the states through the disabled level marker. Table walks proceed through pre order, leaf and post order phases selected by options with shared mode fixed for the whole walk. Invalid entries are tagged as locked for atomic replacement, donated away from the host, or poisoned after reclaim, with annotation preserved alongside the tag.

Indexing the virtualized control area with an out of range CPU number traps. Requesting a shared walk in the hypervisor build fails instead of running unprotected. Range invalidation spans are capped to avoid crossing address halves and a zero granule code is handled as the largest size. Address conversion that ignores large addressing mode or middle page size truncates high bits. Locked, donated and poisoned tags plus the all ones physical value must never be treated as valid mappings.
